answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a voyage of verified work across many epochs, with the stake slashed if juries catch copied or incoherent answers. One honest agent reaches the zenith of trust cheaply and earns the stake back, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate stake for every fake identity and loses them all at once when one is caught — running a haven for fakes becomes ruinous while honest participation stays nearly free.
